params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: type
params.description: Limit results to items of an object type.

params.name: subtype
params.description: Limit results to items of one or more object subtypes.

items.docs: Cross-content search across published objects. A query for `star` returned 68 matches at harvest time. Each result is a lightweight pointer (id, title, url, type, subtype) that can be resolved against the posts, pages or media collections.
